title: Verify my client handles ACP session lifecycles
statement: As a developer building tools around AI harnesses, I can exercise ACP connection and session lifecycles through my own client against a real harness so that my library handles state transitions as well as message contents.

acceptance_criteria.statement: The consumer performs real ACP version and capability negotiation followed by session creation, and can assert its resulting state from native ACP responses. Cordyceps does not substitute a successful handshake or session result.

The consumer starts a prompt turn and consumes native ACP updates under controlled provider behavior, then observes the protocol-defined prompt response and stop reason. Turn completion is distinct from process exit and connection teardown.

For a supported ACP integration, a test can keep a provider exchange pending, request cancellation through the consumer ACP client, and assert the actual protocol and consumer state within a bounded wait, following the negotiated ACP cancellation semantics.
